description: Verify a generated chart locally before deploying: draws the chart.js that generate_chart wrote, headless, against its data - the rows query_semantic_model saved, a CSV, or the rows it was generated for - through @bicharts/chart-host the way the app will, and reports in plain words: the marks drawn by kind, anything thrown (with the line), whether it came out blank, anything drawn outside its frame, and whether a click on a mark reaches onSelect with source rows. Takes seconds; local and free (no network, no credentials, nothing sent). Run it after each generate_chart instead of deploying to see whether a chart works, and check at the size the panel will give it: by default it reads minChartWidth and minChartHeight off the app's BicChartPanel around the chart (else the size it was generated for); pass width and height only for another size. A WARNING line is a label cut off at that size even at a narrow font's width; the reply says whether more room fixes it. Never edit the generated chart code by hand to clear a finding: regenerate it (generate_chart, with a prompt describing the fix) or report it. It does not judge colours or real font widths.

chart.description: The chart's folder name under the project's src/charts (the out_dir given to generate_chart), e.g. "region-map".

chart_path.description: Or the path of the chart.js generate_chart wrote, or the folder it is in.

csv_path.description: Or a CSV with the chart's columns.

data_name.description: The name given to query_semantic_model: checks on the rows it saved (.bic/data/<name>.csv). Default: a saved file named like the chart's folder, else the rows the chart was generated for.

height.description: The height in px to check at (default: the minChartHeight of the app's BicChartPanel around this chart, else the height it was generated for, else 600).

project_dir.description: The app's folder. Defaults to the folder setup_fabric_app used, else the working directory or the one project folder inside it.

width.description: The width in px to check at (default: the minChartWidth of the app's BicChartPanel around this chart, else the width it was generated for, else 800).

name: check_chart
title: Check a generated chart locally
